newsitem.title: UK: Mersey Docks starts new Irish Sea service.
newsitem.headline: Mersey Docks starts new Irish Sea service.

text.p: Coastal Container Line, a wholly owned subsidiary of Mersey Docks and Harbour Co, said Tuesday it is starting a new Irish Sea service to replace that operated by former Irish operator Bell Lines.
The twice weekly container ship service will operate from Waterford's Belview Terminal to Cardiff in South Wales, Coastal Container Line said. The first sailing will be this afternoon.

Coastal Container Line commercial manager Eamon Sullivan said: "We recognise the logistical difficulties facing manufacturers and distributors in the south of Ireland following the loss of Bell Lines."
Bell Lines was put into liquidation by the Dublin High Court at the beginning of this month after an Irish receiver failed to sell the company.
Coastal Container Line already operates services between Dublin, Belfast, Liverpool and Cardiff. -Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
